WebsiteClosers® presents an SBA Pre-Qualified, AI-Powered Medical Device Company that has developed patented robotic hair restoration systems for physicians, clinics, and entrepreneurs entering the fast-growing hair transplant market.

Since launching in 2018, the company has built a strong reputation for combining Artificial Intelligence, Augmented Reality, Robotics, and Proprietary Software into a complete platform that improves the speed, precision, and consistency of hair restoration procedures. These devices are unique in delivering advanced features at a much lower cost, giving customers an attractive alternative without sacrificing performance.

SBA and Seller Financing Opportunity

This business has been pre-qualified for SBA financing, offering a distinct advantage to prospective acquirers. For qualified buyers, this means the company meets stringent lender criteria for consistent cash flow, operational stability, and financial documentation, reducing uncertainty and expediting the lending process. With only 10% down required, buyers can secure ownership through a 10-year, fully amortized loan at competitive fixed interest rates, allowing for an affordable monthly payment structure and maximum leverage of capital. This business also has some Seller Financing available.
